categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of polystyrene (PS) products, including High Impact Polystyrene (HIPS) and General Purpose Polystyrene (GPPS). It focuses on high-value-added, environmentally friendly new materials within the polymer industry, with plans to expand into other synthetic resin fields and deepen modification development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary core technologies, notably a nano-scale in-situ polymerization modification one-step method for HIPS production, which is energy-efficient, environmentally friendly, and cost-effective. It employs advanced manufacturing processes such as DCS (Distributed Control System) for real-time monitoring and intelligent production, and has obtained 27 patents including 7 invention patents related to process and formulation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are in industries such as electronics and electrical appliances, toys, daily plastic products, plastic packaging, building materials, and medical devices. The company serves mainly domestic markets with growing overseas sales, targeting high-end applications requiring high impact resistance and toughness.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with its production base located in the Shantou Free Trade Zone in South China, which is a major plastics industry cluster. It also has expanding export markets in Southeast Asia and other regions, though overseas revenue remains a small portion of total sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the chemical supply chain, focusing on the production of polystyrene resins from purchased raw materials such as styrene monomer. It maintains stable upstream supplier relationships with major petrochemical companies and supplies downstream manufacturers in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes technological innovation, product diversification, and intelligent manufacturing upgrades. It invests in R&D to improve product performance, reduce costs, and develop specialized and customized materials. The company also focuses on digital transformation, green production, and expanding its product portfolio to enhance competitiveness and sustainability.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the direct sale of polystyrene products (HIPS and GPPS) to industrial customers. The company uses a direct sales model and a trade distributor model, with strict prepayment policies. It also earns rental income from investment properties and investment income from financial asset management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the earliest and largest polystyrene producers in South China, holding a leading market position with an annual capacity of 350,000 tons. It competes on scale, technology, product quality, and brand recognition, leveraging its location advantage and strong customer relationships to maintain competitiveness against domestic and international peers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.69 billion, a 6.13% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 97.2 million, up 21.33%. Total assets reached RMB 3.88 billion, growing 11.68% from the previous year. The company shows steady growth with improving profitability and cash flow from operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-quality, high-impact polystyrene products with superior toughness, gloss, and performance tailored to customer needs. Its proprietary nano-scale polymerization technology provides cost and energy efficiency advantages. Strong R&D capabilities, stable supply chain, and proximity to major downstream industries enable responsive service and product customization, creating strong customer loyalty and market differentiation.
